Notes on the plan:
- Roads not used: Suryagadhi hospital to Likhu market (closed), Bidur shelter to Kalika village (buried), Suryagadhi hospital to Syaphru school (bridge washed away), and Likhu market to Nilkantha farm (flood-swept, not needed).
- Tarkeshwar school is not an evacuation point, so the four children there are picked up and carried to Bidur shelter.
- No one is deferred. Car 1 makes four trips (Tarkeshwar children, Kalika elderly and children, Kalika adults with the Nilkantha farmer, Jwalamukhi adults). Car 2 makes three trips (Trishuli elderly, then Syaphru children in two loads).
- Car 1 costs 240 minutes and car 2 costs 188 minutes. The cost is pure driving time because deferral penalties would exceed the driving cost for every group.
